description: The one diagnosis of a reported problem. A refusal lists every problem at once, with the JSON pointer of each field.

title.description: One line, 1 to 120 characters, that names the problem. It becomes the title of an issue only when the report was no issue.

severity.description: How much the problem costs the people who meet it.

confidence.description: How sure the diagnosis is: confirmed when you read the code that fails, probable when one link is inferred, suspected when the cause is plausible but not tied to the report, not_reproducible when the code you read does not produce the problem.

root_cause.description: What is wrong and why it produces what was reported, 1 to 6000 bytes.

affected_files.description: 1 to 30 files you read. May be empty only when the confidence is not_reproducible or there is a question.

path.description: A regular file of the repository, relative to its root. It must exist; a path that does not is refused.

line.description: A line of the file, from 1 to its number of lines.

note.description: What the file has to do with the problem, at most 300 bytes.

suggested_fix.description: What to change, 1 to 6000 bytes. May be empty only when the confidence is not_reproducible or there is a question.

acceptance_criteria.description: 1 to 15 criteria, each something a person or a test can observe when the problem is gone. May be empty only when the confidence is not_reproducible or there is a question.

question.description: Only when two readings of the report lead to opposite fixes, and only with the confidence suspected or not_reproducible.

options.description: No option, for an answer in words, or 2 to 6 options of 1 to 200 bytes.
